race.comment: PEACE SEEKER (9) was very disappointing last start, and though she was trapped wide throughout, she still should have stuck on better than she did. The blinkers are back on in an effort to keep her mind on the job, and with a further drop in class, she deserves a chance to make amends. CAPE RADSTOCK (7) resumes from a spell that would have done her the world of good, and with a couple of jump-outs under her belt, she won't be far away. BACK UP BARBIE (6) has been improving with racing this season and was runner-up as the favourite at Mildura just over 3 weeks ago. A wide gate is against her in this, but she drops 3kg, and is worth following. IRON STUPA (1) worked to find the front from a wide gate last start, and finished third. Stick with him
